<system-reminder>
CUA inputs are still held:
- Key "shift", appHandle "fixture-app" (application input).
- Mouse left, appHandle "fixture-app", windowId "7" (window input).
- Key "w", appHandle "fixture-app" (application input).
They remain pressed across programs and turns. To release them, call sendKeyEvent or toggleMouse on the same target with direction 'up' and the same input options as the down.
</system-reminder>
